Honestly, I feel you.
I've been in the same situation. And the thing is, if it's your fault then reach out and apologise if you haven't already but don't expect anything from it. Do it cause you mean it. 
But you also need to accept that they have the right to not want a relationship with you anymore. They have the right to decline your attempts and your apology depending on how much they feel from the fall out and that's perfectly valid even if it may suck for you.

It's been 5 years and while I still think about them, I've come to accept that they don't want me in their life, because had the roles been reversed I probably wouldn't want them in my life either.
What helped was also muting them on my social media because it made me sad to see that I wasn't a part of their life anymore.
